title: The end-to-end gate passes three consecutive times, so the claim path is exercised between services and not merely unit-tested
mechanism: seven real services over real HTTP and TLS, driven by backend/scripts/mcr/wp10_profile_social.py
mechanism_rationale: docs/mcr/backend/wp04-claims.md § What the end-to-end gate proves about the claim path
independence: Each run enrolled a distinct author identity and started at a distinct instant, roughly 95 seconds apart, against freshly built binaries. The passes are not a cached result.
proven_end_to_end: A viewer with a live claim satisfying the audience sees a restricted post (step 2 detail 200; verification reported status=VERIFIED, claims_present=true).
That viewer can like the restricted post (step 3 like 200).
The author can read the liker list (step 3 likers list 200).
A verified outsider who fails the audience sees nothing on any intro surface (step 5: post 404, comments 404, likers 404).
The audience decision is applied on every intro surface, not only the detail (cross-surface sweep PASS).
A refusal does not echo the restricted body (the cross-surface sweep checks the marker body).
not_proven_end_to_end: A claim expiring mid-session: the expiry boundary is tested against a real database with a fake port, but no gate run watches a live claim lapse between two requests.
A claim revoked or replaced mid-session: unit-tested over the port only.
A provider outage or transport failure during a read: the adapter maps every transport error to Unavailable and a test asserts it, but the gate never takes the profile service down mid-read.
An explicit provider 'unknown' claim end to end: row 11 is covered by the shared case table and the adapter unit test; both gate identities carry a real gender.
Anonymous shared-link resolution: covered by intro_links against a real database, not by the gate.
gaps_observed_in_the_gate: GET /api/me/notifications returns 404 RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE in step 3, and step 3 does not assert on it, so the step passes while the notification inbox is not served. That surface belongs to WP-05 and is outside this work package's evidence.
